selector.rationale: The presence of lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in the cerebrospinal fluid and κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation supports the diagnosis of Leptomeningeal lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (LPL), which is a more specific entity than Leptomeningeal lymphoma.

rejected.label: Central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses various lymphoma types, including leptomeningeal lymphoma

rejected.label: Leptomeningeal metastasis
rejected.why: No evidence of metastasis from another primary site

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence supporting this diagnosis

rejected.label: Rituximab-related secondary lymphoma
rejected.why: No clear link between rituximab treatment and the development of this specific lymphoma type
